big_case.notes: Emergency application by the Solicitor General to stay an injunction against construction at the White House itself, with the President a defendant; separation-of-powers / NHPA-APA reviewability stakes, 2-1 D.C. Circuit affirmance below, seven amicus briefs at the application stage, and heavy national press attention. Among the most-watched applications of the moment, though an interim order rather than a merits landmark.
